The problem

Executives act on the number and the ask

  • $1.37M is not "$1.4M." Someone repeats that figure to a board.
  • The close date must be exact. The update must contain the ask.
  • But LLMs round numbers, drop the ask, and pad with fluff ("synergy", "circle back").
  • And an AI grading its own homework is worthless for numbers people will act on.

The quality gate is real code — never the model's opinion of itself.

The gate

Seven deterministic, unit-tested checks

✓
Length ≤ 120 words
✓
No sentence > 30 words
✓
No banned phrases
✓
Account named
✓
Amount exact
catches $1.37M → $1.4M
✓
Close date exact
✓
The ask is stated
✓
+ Must-mention
stackable composition

Rules live in one config file · 36 unit tests (25 UI + 11 connector).

The money moment

Attempt 1 rounds $1.37M → $1.4M and pads with fluff — rejected. Each failure becomes a targeted correction fed into the next attempt.

Only verified output ships

After two corrected retries every check passes — the exact $1,370,000 and the ask, both present. The badge means code verified it, not the model.

Trust

When it can't verify, it says so

  • The "Ironbridge" deal has no exact close date in the source ("end of Q2").
  • The loop can't invent one, so after 5 attempts it reports an honest failure.
  • It surfaces the best attempt and the one check it could not satisfy.
  • No unverified summary ever ships — the opposite of "I checked, it's fine."

LLM Style Judge — advisory, not the gate

A separate judge scores style of already-verified summaries. It runs only after acceptance and never affects pass/fail — kept deliberately apart from the formal gate.

The loop earns its complexity

20 generations: first-attempt pass 0% → final 75% (+75 pts). It stays below 100% because one deal is genuinely unverifiable — measured honesty.

Pull real deals from Salesforce

Executive-priority SOQL (open + closing this quarter, by amount, top 25) — never thousands at once. Config-gated Dev-org stretch, with an offline mock. The Amount flows in exact, so fact fidelity enforces it.

How it's built

Architecture

  • React + Vite UI · single light/green NextQ theme.
  • Generator and verifier fully decoupled — swap mock ↔ live LLM in one file.
  • Node + jsforce read-only connector · SOQL builder is pure & injection-safe.
  • 36 unit tests, incl. the $1.37M rounding case and SOQL-injection safety.
